variety_description: A medium maturity, medium tall, good yielding variety. Developed by IARI, New Delhi and released in 1994 for irrigated areas of Karnataka and Kerala. It has a long slender non-aromatic grain. Non-lodging and non-shattering.  Exhibits good tolerance to major diseases.
